stem: When computing October's CAC, an analyst counts every customer who placed an order in October as a new customer. What happens to the CAC figure?

options.text: It comes out too high, because returning customers add cost but no customers
It stays correct, because returning customers cost nothing to win back again
It comes out too low, because guest orders are then counted twice over
It comes out too low, as returning customers swell the count of new ones
